scenes.title: Trier Social Stress Test speech gauntlet: 2 minutes prep before two white-coated judges and a tripod camera
scenes.era: 2014 & 2017 University of Michigan & Michigan State Emotion & Self-Control Laboratories

layout.description: Crisp high-key clinical evaluation room with a brushed-chrome floor microphone at left-center facing an oak evaluator table where two motionless figures in crisp white lab coats sit beside a black cinema camera on an aluminum tripod.

positions.who: Job-speech participant (clothed matte-white porcelain figure with smooth featureless solid matte-white egg-shaped oval head in navy-blue knit crew sweater and gray trousers)
positions.where: standing behind the brushed-chrome floor microphone facing the evaluator table
positions.facing: facing the two white-coated judges and tripod camera

positions.who: Two evaluative judges (clothed matte-white porcelain figures with smooth featureless solid matte-white egg-shaped oval heads in crisp buttoned white lab coats)
positions.where: seated side-by-side behind the oak table flanking the black tripod camera with unmarked clipboards
positions.facing: facing the standing speaker in complete stillness

props.name: brushed-chrome floor microphone stand and black cinema camera on aluminum tripod
props.period_detail: classic Kirschbaum (1993) & Kross (2014) Trier Social Stress Test speech apparatus
props.physical_behavior: speaker's porcelain hands initially grip the chrome stand tightly under 'I' self-talk, then release into calm open gestures after silent first-name shift

props.name: two unmarked wooden clipboards resting on the oak judge table
props.period_detail: clean blank paper sheets held by motionless white-coated evaluators
props.physical_behavior: evaluators sit stone-still taking silent notes as the speaker delivers the 5-minute speech

actions.verb_sequence: releases a tense two-handed grip on the chrome microphone stem -> stands tall with open calm porcelain hands facing the two white-coated judges

reactions.reaction: incline their smooth white oval heads slightly as they mark strong speech performance on blank clipboards

scenes.wardrobe: Speaker in navy-blue knit sweater and tailored gray slacks; two evaluators in crisp white lab coats over dark collars.
scenes.recognition_hook: Standing alone at a microphone facing stone-faced judges and a camera — where swapping one silent word in your head changes everything in 1,000 milliseconds.

key_visual.description: porcelain speaker in navy-blue sweater standing at a chrome floor microphone facing two white-coated porcelain judges seated behind a table beside a black tripod camera

scenes.title: 2017 Michigan State ERP & fMRI recording: 1-second emotional voltage drop with zero willpower strain
scenes.era: 2017 Michigan State University ERP & University of Michigan fMRI suites

layout.description: Bright neurophysiology booth where a porcelain volunteer wearing a sleek white electrode cap sits calmly before an unmarked waveform screen.

positions.who: Volunteer in navy sweater and white sensor cap

props.name: white scalp sensor cap and unmarked waveform screen
props.period_detail: clean text-free voltage trace dropping from tall crimson peak to low calm blue line
props.physical_behavior: tall jagged wave drops smoothly within one second while subject's hands stay relaxed

actions.verb_sequence: sits calmly wearing the white sensor cap -> lowers shoulders as the screen trace drops smoothly

reactions.reaction: points calmly toward the rapid wave drop

scenes.wardrobe: Navy-blue sweater and white lab coat.
scenes.recognition_hook: Millisecond brain waves drop inside 1 second without burning prefrontal willpower.

scenes.title: Contained Living 4-Color 3D Brain medial cutaway: amygdala & midline self-loop cooling without frontoparietal strain

layout.description: Bright white architectural gallery with Contained Living 4-Color 3D Brain medial-sagittal cutaway on matte-white pedestal.

props.name: translucent medial 3D brain cutaway
props.physical_behavior: crimson-red amygdala and medial prefrontal chatter flares cool rapidly into calm pearl-aqua and electric cyan-blue

actions.verb_sequence: flashes crimson-red in deep amygdala and midline prefrontal hub -> cools within one second into smooth pearl-aqua waves

reactions.reaction: upper dorsolateral willpower cortex stays cool and unstrained

scenes.recognition_hook: Shows why silent name-switching works even when panic leaves willpower empty.
